Usage: astryx theme remove [options] <slug>

Remove a non-default theme from the app

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the module is regenerated without the theme
  1  the theme is not added, is the default, or state is invalid

Examples:
  # Remove an added theme
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme remove ocean

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-remove
